abstain_regex: not in (the )?(context|corpus|excerpts?)|no (information|mention|record|adr|decision)|(does|do|did) not (say|specify|mention|state|contain|describe|cover|include)|not (stated|specified|mentioned|found|covered|provided|available)|cannot (find|answer|be determined)|unable to find|no .{0,40}(was|were) found|NOT IN CONTEXT|insufficient
scoring: A non-abstain question is correct when every group in all_of has at least one regex alternative that matches the answer (case-insensitive, re.search). An abstain question (empty all_of) is correct when abstain_regex matches the answer and the answer is under 600 characters.

questions.question: How many required status contexts were kept intact when the OCC merge queue was removed?
questions.gold: Seven (7) required status contexts were kept intact.

questions.question: Which library and version renders Pydantic-generated JSON Schema with no custom field?
questions.gold: @rjsf/core 6.5.1 with @rjsf/validator-ajv8.

questions.question: What are the three tiers of agent routing, in the order they run?
questions.gold: Tier 1 explicit trigger matching, tier 2 LLM-based semantic routing, tier 3 fuzzy trigger matching.

questions.question: Which single aggregate rollup context does omnibase_core keep as required under Model B?
questions.gold: CI Summary.

questions.question: What does the routing hook return when no candidate is above the confidence threshold?
questions.gold: An explicit no-match signal (matched: false, reason no_candidate_above_threshold) and no agent selection.

questions.question: Which ADR number belonged to the withdrawn July 2026 beta priority lock, and which ADR superseded it?
questions.gold: ADR-0021, superseded by ADR-0053.

questions.question: How many characters is the sanitized prompt preview sent to the observability topic?
questions.gold: 100 characters.

questions.question: Why does Dependabot PR approval remain a manual step?
questions.gold: It is a GitHub platform limitation, not a pipeline gap, so it stays manual.

questions.question: Which ordering values may a projection use for canonical ordering, and when may event time be used?
questions.gold: Ingest-assigned sequence, projection version or another contracted monotonic value; event_time_ms only when its clock authority is defined by contract.

questions.question: Why was a dashboard card that shows tiles plus a list of recommendations kept out of the generic tile cluster component?
questions.gold: It stays bespoke: the tile adapter models a flat array of uniform tiles with no slot for a secondary heterogeneous recommendation list.

questions.question: What was the real reason merges stalled in July 2026, and what was done about it?
questions.gold: A merge-sweep tooling miss (the skill-based sweep did not work), not a capacity deadlock; merges were driven by the runbook and manual sweep.

questions.question: What rule stops the base library from importing network, queue or database client packages directly, and what is used in their place?
questions.gold: Core has a forbidden-dependency table; protocol interfaces such as ProtocolHttpClient replace the client libraries.

questions.question: How is an empty dashboard state made checkable by a machine?
questions.gold: The typed reason value is exposed on the data-empty-state-reason attribute.

questions.question: Why was driving the Dependabot approval with a browser robot turned down?
questions.gold: It is fragile: it depends on GitHub UI structure and needs browser session management.

questions.question: Who may write the evidence companion for a change, and who may not?
questions.gold: Only the autogen tick or an independent verifier; the implementing agent must not author its own.

questions.question: What keeps a language model's claim from changing the state of the factory control loop?
questions.gold: The control plane is a deterministic FSM that consumes only verified facts from gates; models are gated candidate generators.

questions.question: When processing cannot proceed correctly, what may the system do and what must it never do?
questions.gold: It may delay, quarantine, dead-letter or mark projections degraded; it must not silently drop events, guess missing state, reorder without authority or present degraded data as complete.

questions.question: The decision that replaced the two-database split uses how many physical databases and how many contract-declared domains?
questions.gold: One physical application database with three contract-declared domains (ADR-0027, which supersedes ADR-0026).

questions.question: Which accepted decision replaced the July beta priority lock, and what does its beta consist of?
all_of: own (model )?keys?|bring your own|own API key|own key
questions.gold: ADR-0053: a local install, the user's own model keys, no hosted service.

questions.question: Reducer output exceptions defer to a later decision as the canonical statement of the pattern. Which one, and which exception class does it use?
questions.gold: ADR-0037, which uses ModelOnexError.

questions.question: The core-infra dependency boundary decision relates to a risk record about transport-import branch protection. What status does that risk record carry?
questions.gold: Mitigated (ADR-0038).

questions.question: What does RSD stand for after the renaming decision, and what does the decision it umbrellas propose?
questions.gold: Recursive System Design; it umbrellas ADR-0052, adaptive recursive contract bisection.

questions.question: What superseded the two-database decision, and what were the tenant database's invariant requirements?
questions.gold: ADR-0027 superseded it; the old tenant-database invariant I-1 required tenant_id NOT NULL, forced row-level security and a tenant-isolation policy.

questions.question: One decision removes YAML loading from the synchronous hook path and another forbids silent fallback in routing. What does each of them have the hook return?
questions.gold: The first returns a JSON list of candidate agents with confidence scores; the second returns an explicit no-match signal instead of silently substituting general-purpose.

questions.question: Which two other doctrine documents does the degrade-safely doctrine reference?
questions.gold: fail-fast-and-loud and authoritative-projections-own-truth.

questions.question: List the ADRs that concern the omnidash dashboard.
Which ADRs are superseded or withdrawn?
questions.gold: ADR-0021 (withdrawn, superseded by 0053) and ADR-0026 (superseded by 0027).

questions.question: Which ADRs are dated 2026-02-19?
Why was the nightly lab canary moved off Thursday, and what is the decision code?
questions.gold: It overlapped the weekly firmware window; decision PL-4471.

questions.question: What number fixes the sampling in the pilot that estimates spend?
questions.gold: The fixed seed is 8123.

questions.question: How long are files kept in scratch on the second pool host, and what drives that number?
questions.gold: 19 days: 17 days of history plus 2 days of slack.

questions.question: When does documentation review duty change hands each month, and what happens when that date is a weekend?
questions.gold: The 14th at 09:30 Eastern; on a weekend it moves to the next Monday.

questions.question: What is the team's name for freezing a pass bar before any result, and which experiment first used it?
questions.gold: Lantern Pass; the durable-workflow experiment on the first pool host.

questions.question: Who receives escalations for the billing sandbox now, and what prompted the change?
questions.gold: The platform on-call role, after two missed pages.

questions.question: What is the maximum number of retries the Gamma scheduler allows per job?
questions.gold: The corpus does not say.

questions.question: Which ADR chose PostgreSQL logical replication for tenant failover?
questions.gold: No ADR in the corpus says this.
